snapshot_policy: 非规范可读快照，不是第二真源。实时状态以 governance/active_plan_registry.json 为准，范围与验收解释以对应 Plan 和绑定证据为准。

hierarchy_definition.level_1: workstream：业务或治理主线，定义 owner、状态、next_gate 与文档归属。
hierarchy_definition.level_2: closure unit：closure_backlog.units 中唯一可执行待办，包含依赖、execution_mode、wave 和 exit_gate。
hierarchy_definition.level_3: Plan 内的命名子切片或执行检查点；不全局登记，必须连同父单元和 Plan 路径解释。
hierarchy_definition.wave: 跨单元排序与治理阶段属性，不单独作为第四级或第一级。
hierarchy_definition.checkpoint: Plan 的执行回写，只记录检查点，不自动成为独立可领取单元。

status_definitions.completed: 该 closure unit 已满足其登记退出门；不代表其他单元、工作流或后续生产目标自动完成。
status_definitions.active: 该单元正在其实施或收口阶段；是否可领取仍须读取 execution_focus、execution_mode 和依赖。
status_definitions.planned: 已登记需求和退出门，但尚未完成；planned 不等于已获当前施工窗口。
status_definitions.waiting_dependency: 仍等待一个或多个依赖单元，不能仅凭代码可用提前记为完成。
status_definitions.awaiting_production: 剩余退出门需要真实生产证据、授权动作或生产验收。
status_definitions.blocked_external: 剩余工作受外部环境、权限或第三方条件阻断。
status_definitions.production_validation: 工作流状态：主要缺口已进入真实数据、迁移、观察或生产验收。
status_definitions.external_validation: 工作流状态：主要缺口需要外部环境或外部主体验收。
status_definitions.open: 三级 Plan 子切片尚未关闭；它不是 Registry 的二级单元状态。

reading_rules: Plan 定义范围、方法和退出门；Registry 提供实时单元状态与唯一执行焦点。
completed 只覆盖该单元的 execution_mode 和 exit_gate，不能外推为生产、真实用户或实盘资格。
代号前缀不能替代 workstream_id；GOV-01/02 展示了历史或跨工作流归属。
三级代号只保证其 Plan 语境内的意义，其他 Plan 可出现相同 C1/C2 等标识。
本快照完整展开全部一级工作流和二级单元；三级详细展开当前询问的 TUX 与 ASH，其他 Plan 的内部小节仍从对应文档读取。

Preserve DATA/EVID/QMT, production and research-only stops; no fixture or claimed capability grants authority.

closure_waves.rule: Dispose of the review queue without opening a new implementation line.

level_1_workstreams.next_gate: The 2026-10-10 review-queue deadline elapsed without a retained review decision. MHD-01 is a planned governance review unit, not an implementation authorization. Review or archive the draft with an explicit owner decision before separately approving any feasibility probe or MVP. The queue is transferred to this explicit workstream; no deadline extension, review approval or development start is implied.

level_2_units.title: Resolve expired Manager Holdings draft review without authorizing implementation
level_2_units.exit_gate: A retained owner review decision explicitly accepts, revises or archives the draft. Any feasibility probe and MVP remain separately authorized decisions; no provider access, implementation or production change follows merely from plan registration.

level_1_workstreams.title: A-share research, simulation and controlled execution usability
level_1_workstreams.scope_zh: A 股规则、结算、数据能力、调仓与受控执行
level_1_workstreams.next_gate: MCP default account-scope bounded acceptance: 1399 tests passed before registry checks. Preview resolves owner-scoped eligible accounts and binds copied IDs to confirmation; newly added accounts cannot silently expand execution. Exact upstream HTTP 403 is retained. Next: C3c truthful import outcomes/counts, qualified settlement/PIT/source work. Full ASH01-12 Goal, production, broker, RC and S6 remain open. Evidence: docs/testing/a-share-usability-mcp-default-scope-2026-10-18.json

level_2_units.title: Inventory A-share consumer paths, supported scope and authoritative rule sources
level_2_units.exit_gate: Every core buy/add/sell/close/import/repair/backtest/QMT path has an owner, actual consumer, rule/cost source, time contract and failure-test mapping. The security/board/mode support matrix and existing-contract reuse decisions are explicit. Reproduce verified defects before implementation; do not infer production coverage from static code or begin provider/live activity.

level_2_units.title: Unify versioned A-share tradability rules and server/Agent validation
level_2_units.exit_gate: Risk-owned versioned rules and Data Center evidence cover declared boards, order quantities/odd lots, price ticks and boundary modes, sessions, source freshness and account permissions. Unknown state fails closed; server and Agent agree on the same bound input, version and hash. No fractional quantity truncation or historical constant fallback. Behavior, architecture and type checks pass without enabling live execution.

level_2_units.title: Repair settlement, reservations, simulated fills and cost consistency
level_2_units.exit_gate: Stock T+1 and other declared security settlement classes distinguish economic, unsettled, sellable and reserved quantities over real sessions. Normal simulation, actual-fill import and corrections have explicit cost/fee contracts without duplicate charging or invented zero cost. PostgreSQL concurrency, duplicate/partial/cancel/recovery and rollback evidence proves no oversell or double spend. Historical correction remains previewed and separately bounded.

level_2_units.title: Propagate source-time and per-asset usable capabilities to decision consumers
level_2_units.exit_gate: Published/PIT reads retain observation, availability and knowledge cutoff; intraday execution rejects missing or stale source time. Per-asset capability isolation preserves verified market functions while blocking missing financial functions, full denominators and identity/audit/scope checks. Future reports, stale caches and failover regressions pass; TUI displays actionable capabilities without implicit business writes. Existing DATA production gates stay independent.

level_2_units.title: Connect announcements and corporate actions to positions and plan validity
level_2_units.exit_gate: Source-bound event versions distinguish announcement, availability and effective stages; recommendation/plan validity and account cash/share effects reuse existing owners and Audit/Outbox. Duplicate, late, revised, dividend/stock-distribution/rights and deferred-fee cases replay without duplicate posting or adjusted-price double counting. Unknown events remain UNKNOWN; missing source coverage stays explicit.

level_2_units.title: Make A-share backtests respect PIT, sessions, fills and net costs
level_2_units.exit_gate: Historical universes/PIT data, signal versus earliest-fill time, exchange sessions, board rules, settlement, capacity, corporate actions and both-side costs are replayable. Limit/suspension/unfilled exits remain positions rather than fabricated cash; stop triggers do not imply fills. Golden cases, future-data perturbation and matched simulation reconciliation pass. Evidence-based trust levels retain unsupported assumptions.

level_2_units.title: Enforce portfolio concentration, liquidity and outstanding-order risk
level_2_units.exit_gate: Versioned risk policy uses source-bound sector/ETF coverage, capacity and settled/reserved account projections at planning and execution. Pending sales do not release risk or buying power prematurely. Sector concentration, duplicate exposure, stale/partial look-through, low liquidity, simultaneous orders and blocked-exit stress cases produce explainable constraints using existing Scenario services.

level_2_units.title: Deliver an account-specific rebalance plan and complete TUI user journey
level_2_units.exit_gate: Plans expose current/sellable and target shares, feasible deltas, costs, cash, dependencies, versions, expiry and invalidation. Partial fills/cancel/expiry recompute remaining work without mutating approved fields. Existing TransitionPlan and exact bindings are reused. Ordinary/read-only/cross-account browser, API and SDK/MCP contracts pass with actionable empty/blocked states and no new Classic business page.

level_2_units.title: Wire exact Evidence and current risk authorization through live-order checkpoints
level_2_units.exit_gate: Existing canonical account/plan/order/risk receipts and authority bind exact scope, hashes, versions and validity at create/approve/lease/submitting. Revocation, policy/quote drift, tampering, lease expiry and uncertain submission fail closed or reconcile without duplicate broker calls. Isolated PostgreSQL and Agent regressions pass; no constant-true rollout, generic bypass or production activation is introduced. EVID/QMT production acceptance stays separate. The decision-to-reconciliation event chain preserves applicable source/received timestamps, clock provenance, account/plan/order/approval versions and idempotent sequencing; missing broker source time remains null and recovery reconciles broker facts rather than inferring orders from local logs alone.

level_2_units.title: Reconcile real-account performance, recommendation lineage and execution costs
level_2_units.exit_gate: Returns distinguish external cash flows, dividends, actual costs and valuation with explicit benchmark and weighting method. Exact recommendation/plan/order/fill lineage is reused; uncertain manual matches and attribution residuals stay visible. Cash-flow, duplicate/partial-fill, corporate-action and unmatched-trade golden cases reconcile to the ledger at declared precision, with report limitations when reconciliation is incomplete. A versioned execution-quality report distinguishes decision, arrival and limit benchmarks from actual fill VWAP and covers buy/sell direction, fee inclusion, filled/unfilled quantities, price slippage, delay cost and opportunity cost with explicit source observation/availability times. Missing benchmark or timestamp evidence produces unavailable/limited rather than zero-slippage or current-price backfill.

level_2_units.title: Accept candidate-bound A-share research, manual-assistance and simulation journeys
level_2_units.exit_gate: One candidate binds applicable CI/S6, real data capabilities, rule/cost/configuration/TUI versions and recoverability. Ordinary-user research, holdings, feasible plan, authorized actual-fill import, partial completion, reconciliation and review journeys pass across permitted roles and supported scopes. Partial capabilities remain restricted and live execution stays separately gated; no old candidate window is inherited.

authorization_required: Deploy or switch a candidate/configuration, run production migrations/backfill/corrections or execute write-side UAT such as real-fill import or approval. Prepare bounded preflight, dry-run, impact and rollback first and honor any existing applicable authorization.
human_or_external_required: Business owners judge the actual A/B user outcomes and support limits; missing genuine data or required independent acceptance cannot be replaced with fixture or agent signatures.

level_2_units.title: Verify scoped formal QMT execution against existing Evidence and broker exits
level_2_units.exit_gate: Reuse current EVID-03 and QMT-01/02 evidence, then verify the same candidate/account/board/session scope with real target Windows/XtQuant fields and permissions, continuous simulation, controlled small-value orders/cancels, recovery and four-way reconciliation. Existing stops and unsupported scopes remain explicit; no mock-only proof, automatic live enablement or implied capital expansion satisfies the exit. Candidate-bound buy/sell, partial-fill, reject, cancel and duplicate/out-of-order evidence includes applicable decision/ACK/fill/cancel timing, actual fees, slippage and unfilled impact; missing benchmark or broker-time evidence degrades the report, and reconnect or duplicate callbacks cannot create a second broker order or ledger entry.

authorization_required: Enable live execution or send any actual order/cancel, change a production rule or risk limit, or inject a live fault. Present exact account/security/value/time scope, stop criteria, expected costs and recovery steps before the action unless already authorized.
human_or_external_required: The broker supplies working target XtQuant permissions and environment; genuine account/strategy owners and required reviewers accept the scoped live and recovery outcomes under the existing QMT process.
